Class CompileAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.example.bluej.CompileAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
public class CompileAdapter extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
Adapter: converts BlueJ's compile events into EventType.COMPILE_SUCCESS and EventType.COMPILE_ERROR events. Only compiles the student starts are recorded; BlueJ's automatic background error checks are ignored, so the counts match what the student did.
